answer: Form each agent into a small mutual-surety circle: five strangers jointly underwrite one another's identity with a shared bond, like an ivory tower resting on one onyx keystone — pull it and the whole arch falls. Circles are reshuffled every epoch, so a Sybil farmer cannot cluster fakes together; planting one fake means bribing four honest members. The network takes the pulse of each circle by spot-checking one member per round. Limit: an honest member loses its bond if a stranger in its circle turns out fake, and whole circles can collude to vouch for each other.
